name: Jim Gray
summary: James P. Gray II (born August 18, 1953) is an American politician who was the Kentucky secretary of transportation in the administration of Governor Andy Beshear from 2019 to 2026. He was previously the mayor of Lexington, Kentucky from 2011 to 2019. Gray served as the city's vice mayor from 2007 to 2010 before being elected mayor in November 2010.
